command_line:
set -eu
tar -xzf "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79095324/inputs/dataset_698db461-2e1a-45ef-a27f-f2ce8ee957de.dat"
python -m pip install --no-deps --target "$PWD/.deps" 'pandas==2.2.3' 'patsy==1.0.1' 'statsmodels==0.14.4'
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/.deps"
python prepare_amulet_inputs.py "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79095324/inputs/dataset_3af67623-14db-47ae-9524-5fa8d5d56a1b.dat" singlecell.csv
ln -s "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79095324/inputs/dataset_e911cf74-447c-45fb-97d4-372f48fe2637.dat" fragments.tsv
mkdir overlap_out amulet_out
python FragmentFileOverlapCounter.py --expectedoverlap 2 --maxinsertsize 900 fragments.tsv singlecell.csv human_autosomes.txt overlap_out
python AMULET.py --q 0.01 --qrep 0.01 --expectedoverlap 2 overlap_out/Overlaps.txt overlap_out/OverlapSummary.txt amulet_out
python finalize_amulet.py amulet_out/MultipletProbabilities.txt amulet_probabilities.tsv amulet_top_candidate.txt amulet_diagnostics.json
